sourceScope.primary: Official Oakland County candidate list updated October 30, 2026; re-fetched from the current official election page November 3.
sourceScope.candidateList: Every local office field on pages 11–36, excluding state Supreme Court and statewide fields.
sourceScope.sampleCoverage: Farmington Hills: all 24 posted precinct styles, 48 pages. Southfield: all 36 posted styles, 72 pages. Bloomfield Township: all 13 posted PDF styles, 26 pages. Waterford: 3 of 22 posted styles, six pages. These four municipalities do not exhaust Oakland County.
sourceScope.sampleVsRoster: 27 complete named fields corroborated by exact official sample page/column; 90 other named fields have current official-list evidence only.
sourceScope.readerFailures: Michigan Voter Information Center sample endpoint was blocked; its successful reader capture was only a loading/selection shell and is not candidate evidence. Bloomfield Hills city PDFs were blocked; Bloomfield Township is a separate successfully captured jurisdiction.

identityPolicy: Reuse 18 held Michigan judicial contest IDs and six Wayne lane contest IDs (one overlaps baseline); all existing candidacy IDs matched within exact office. Shared Schoolcraft and Clarenceville canonical source-supported Wayne names are preserved, with exact Oakland printed variations recorded separately.
